# 📋 Job Description & ATS Alignment Analysis: CloudSEK

**Target Company:** [CloudSEK](https://cloudsek.com/) (Headquartered in Singapore / Bengaluru, India)  
**Role Title:** SDE Intern - Backend  
**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka, India  
**Application Type:** Internship  
**Company Domain:** AI-powered Cybersecurity, Threat Intelligence & Attack Surface Monitoring (XVigil, BeVigil, SVigil, AIVigil)  
**Funding & Recognition:** $19M Series A+ led by Tenacity Ventures & Commvault (2025), $7M Series A (MassMutual Ventures), NVIDIA Inception Program, NASSCOM-DSCI Security Product Company of the Year, NetApp Excellerator Best Growth Strategy.  
**Analysis Date:** 2026-10-16  

---

## 1. Role Overview & Core Mission

CloudSEK is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. Their product suite includes:
- **CloudSEK XVigil:** Maps digital assets, detects threats, and enriches them with cyber intelligence with automated remediation workflows.
- **CloudSEK BeVigil:** Attack Surface Monitoring tool utilizing mobile, web, network, and encryption scanners to protect known and unknown assets.
- **CloudSEK SVigil:** Contextual AI platform identifying software supply chain risks across cloud services, code, and third-party dependencies.
- **CloudSEK AIVigil:** AI-native Attack Surface Monitoring platform that continuously discovers, monitors, and secures exposed AI infrastructure, MCP servers, leaked AI credentials, vector databases, agentic workflows, and shadow AI across the internet.

As an **SDE Intern - Backend**, the candidate will collaborate with backend engineering teams, data scientists, and product managers to design, develop, and maintain scalable backend systems and components powering these cybersecurity products.

## 2. Technical Requirements & Keyword Classification

### 🔑 Keyword Tiers

| Tier | Priority Level | Technologies & Concepts in JD |
|---|---|---|
| **Tier 1** | **Must-Have (Core)** | **NodeJS or Go**, Backend systems & component design, Clean & scalable code, REST APIs & web protocols (HTTP/HTTPS, JSON), Databases (SQL, schema design principles, query performance). |
| **Tier 2** | **Strongly Preferred** | Distributed systems & Caching mechanisms (**Redis**, caching strategies), Job queues (**BullMQ** / task scheduling), Microservices architecture, Performance debugging & defect resolution, Code reviews & maintainability. |
| **Tier 3** | **Preferred / Nice-to-Have** | Containerization (**Docker**), Orchestration (**Kubernetes**), Cloud platforms (**AWS**, Azure, GCP), CI/CD pipelines (**GitHub Actions**, Jenkins), NoSQL databases (**MongoDB**). |
| **Tier 4** | **Domain & Security Context** | Cybersecurity awareness, Data encryption (**AES-256-GCM**, hashing, key management), Secure API design (input validation, authentication, JWT), AI/Vector security (Pinecone, MCP servers, vector DBs aligned with CloudSEK AIVigil). |
| **Tier 5** | **Generic / Professional** | Problem-solving & analytical thinking, Technical documentation & specs, Cross-functional collaboration (front-end, data science, PMs), Self-motivated fast-paced execution. |

## 5. Tailoring Strategy for `companies/cloudsek/main.tex`

1. **Tagline (`\resumeSubtitle`):**  
   `SDE Intern - Backend | Scalable APIs, Distributed Systems, Node.js \& Databases`
2. **Technical Skills Prioritization:**  
   - Lead with **Languages & Core CS**: JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, Node.js, Go, Python, C++, Java, SQL
   - Follow with **Backend & Systems**: Fastify, Express.js, REST APIs, Microservices, Clean Architecture, Zod Validation, JWT Auth
   - Highlight **Databases & Distributed Systems**: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQLite, Redis (Distributed Queues & Locks), BullMQ, Prisma ORM
   - Conclude with **Cloud, DevOps & Security**: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS (S3, EC2), GitHub Actions, Linux (POSIX), AES-256-GCM, Git
3. **Projects Selection:**

   - **Project 2:** **PatentIQ | AI Prior-Art & Novelty Engine** — Emphasize Fastify backend, Clean Architecture, Prisma ORM/PostgreSQL persistence, Zod validation, and vector database integration (linking to CloudSEK AIVigil).
   - **Open Source:** **ESLint Core (PR #21218)** — Showcases peer review excellence, AST static analysis, precision bug fixing, and passing 43 automated CI checks.
4. **Experience:**  
   - **Students Special Group (Web Developer):** Emphasize relational database design, secure REST API development, and mentoring 50+ students in backend engineering.
